_readme: Template for `npm run audit -- <path>`. Copy it to tests/private/<name>.json (gitignored) and fill in your own courses. Keys starting with _ are comments; the CLI ignores them. All values below are fictional dummies.
_program: Program you are admitted to. Only "BBA" is supported. Used to resolve 'only open to business administration majors' prerequisite restrictions.
_admissionTerm: Term you were admitted to the BBA, as YYYY-season (season = spring, summer, fall). BUS 203/300/496 rows apply to admissions from 2022-fall.
_declaredConcentrations: Zero or more of: Accounting, Finance, Human Resource Management, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, International Business, Management Information Systems, Marketing, Operations Management, Strategic Analysis. Only declared concentrations are audited.
_courses: One entry per attempt (list a repeated course twice). Fields: code = "DEPT NUMBER" as in the calendar, e.g. "BUS 217W"; grade = A+ A A- B+ B B- C+ C C- D F FD N P W, or CR for transfer credit, or null if not finished; units = optional, only needed for a course the app has no data for; term = YYYY-season; institution = "SFU" or "transfer" (transfer courses use the SFU equivalent code); status = "completed", "in_progress" or "planned" (planned courses are ignored by the audit).
